name: Bernal Heights Neighborhood Center - Food Pantries & Senior Food Boxes
description: Bernal Heights Neighborhood Center runs weekly free food pantries with the SF-Marin Food Bank and a monthly senior food box program at its Cortland Avenue and Excelsior senior centers.
fullDescription: Bernal Heights Neighborhood Center runs weekly free food pantries with the SF-Marin Food Bank and a monthly senior food box program at its Cortland Avenue and Excelsior senior centers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Four weekly food pantries in partnership with SF-Marin Food Bank (one visit per week, no cost)
- Fresh fruits, vegetables, grains, protein, and pantry items
- Monthly food box for qualifying seniors 60+ (federal Commodity Supplemental Food Program)
- Senior program services for adults 60+ and adults with disabilities, in English, Spanish, Mandarin, and Cantonese
howToGetIt: Call the senior program at (415) 289-9346 to learn about pantry days and times and whether you qualify for the monthly senior food box. Sites are at 515 Cortland Avenue and 4468 Mission Street.
